name: WriteValuesToSpecificColumns
label: Write Values to Specific Excel Columns
description: Writes a list of values to user-specified Excel columns in a single row (e.g., value1→A, value2→D, value3→G).

fields.name: WorksheetInstance
fields.label: Worksheet Instance
fields.description: The Excel Worksheet instance where values will be written.

fields.name: ValuesToWrite
fields.label: Values to Write
fields.description: A list or array of values (e.g., from JSON fields).

fields.name: TargetColumns
fields.label: Target Columns
fields.description: Column letters for each value (e.g., ['A','D','G','E','W','X']). Must match value count.

fields.name: Row
fields.label: Row
fields.description: The row number to write the data to (e.g., 5).
